fields.name: file
fields.description: Set filename to store the records. If not set, the filename will be the tag associated with the records.

fields.name: format
fields.description: The format of the file content.

fields.name: mkdir
fields.description: Recursively create output directory if it doesn't exist. Permissions set to 0755.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Directory path to store files. If not set, Fluent Bit will write the files in its own working directory.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
